modelDescription: Refined for the mountain and built to go further, the Fierce MTN Reaper 2.0 is the lightest folding chassis rifle in the Fierce lineup — purpose-built for backcountry hunters who refuse to choose between performance and packability. Combining a Dual-Lug Titanium Action with an ultra-light magnesium chassis, C3 carbon fiber stock, M-LOK carbon fiber handguard, and a hand-lapped C3 carbon barrel, the titanium configuration starts at just 5.8 lbs with a .5 MOA accuracy guarantee.
